summary: Frontend-only regression of the rebuilt Bank Eligibilities section on /admin/files/6d194952-c102-4c4b-89b4-7917c2f1fb02. Existing legacy banks render correctly (POONAWALA/KOTAK/ICICI show 'Not Eligible' + reason; AXIS BANK expands with Login=Yes, Application ID MLP000140418403, SM Name 'Chandra Shekhar', SM Number, Approval=Declined with reason and 'logged on'/'rejected on' timestamps). Progressive field reveal/hide is 100% correct in every branch (No -> only Not Eligible Reason; Yes -> Eligible Amount + ROI + Login block; Login=No -> only Login Rejection Reason; Login=Yes -> Login Bank + Application ID + SM Name + SM Number + Approval block; Approval=Declined -> Declined Bank + Decline Reason and NO Disbursement; Approval=Approved -> Approved Bank/Amount/Tenure/ROI + Disbursement block; Disbursed=Yes -> disbursal_date/bank/amount/tenure/roi + commission_percentage + read-only commission_amount). Per-bank Save persisted a full lifecycle (Eligible Yes -> Login Yes with SM fields -> Approved -> Disbursed 500000 @ 1.5%): after browser RELOAD every value came back including SM Name 'QA Sales Manager', SM Number 9998887777, Application ID APP_TESTQA_001, Eligible ROI 10.5, Disbursal Date 2026-01-15, and commission_amount = 7500 (read-only, greenish background) with transition timestamps 'logged on ...', 'approved on ...', 'disbursed on ...' shown. Delete + reload also persisted (bank removed from DB, not only local state). Max 7 gate works: with 4 existing + 3 added banks the 'Add Bank' button became disabled=True. Manager role (teja): SM Name/SM Number fields are disabled=True while other eligibility fields remain editable and the '(Admin/Ops)' label is rendered. HOWEVER a CRITICAL bug was found: the 'Save All' button is completely broken and never persists anything.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Save All' throws 'TypeError: rows.filter is not a function' and never PUTs /files/{id}/eligibilities. onClick binds the handler directly (onClick={handleSaveEligibilities}) so React passes the SyntheticEvent as the `rows` argument; the function then calls event.filter(...) on line 267 and rejects. Reproduction: open file, click Add Bank 3 times, fill bank_name + is_eligible=no + not_eligible_reason on each, click 'Save All', reload -> all 3 banks are gone (only the 4 pre-existing banks remain). No toast is shown (matches the no-optimistic-success intent, but the user thinks the click did nothing). The per-bank 'Save' button is fine because it goes through handleSaveBank(index) which explicitly passes eligibilities.

action_items: FIX (one-line) in /app/frontend/src/pages/files/FileDetailsPage.js line 813: change `onClick={handleSaveEligibilities}` to `onClick={() => handleSaveEligibilities()}` so React does not pass the click event as the `rows` argument to handleSaveEligibilities.
critical_code_review_comments: FileDetailsPage.js line 813 - passing an event-consuming handler directly to onClick when the first positional parameter is `rows = eligibilities` is a footgun; consider always calling `handleSaveEligibilities()` explicitly or renaming the signature so a stray event does not silently become the data payload.

handleSaveEligibilities silently coerces the pre-check failure into a false return but does not distinguish between 'validation blocked' and 'server rejected' for the caller; when Save All is fixed, ensure the toast for the type-error path also exists in case a future regression sneaks in.

In the reload path, commission_amount is server-computed and rendered read-only correctly, but the input still has no `readonly` HTML attribute (only a class change); Playwright get_attribute('readonly') returned empty. Consider setting readOnly on the input for accessibility and to prevent copy/paste edits.

rca of the issue: Save All bug: FileDetailsPage.js line 813 has `onClick={handleSaveEligibilities}`. React invokes onClick handlers with a SyntheticEvent object. Because `handleSaveEligibilities` has signature `(rows = eligibilities, successMessage = 'Bank eligibilities saved')`, the event becomes `rows`. Line 267 then executes `rows.filter(b => (b.bank_name || '').trim())` which throws `TypeError: rows.filter is not a function` (event objects don't have .filter). The catch block on line 279 would normally show a toast, but the throw happens BEFORE the try/catch (line 267 is above `setSavingEligibilities(true)` at line 272 and inside the try only from line 273 onward), so it bubbles up as a page-level PAGEERROR. Net effect: click Save All -> no API call, no toast, no state change, and any newly added (unsaved) banks stay only in local state and are wiped on reload. Fix: `onClick={() => handleSaveEligibilities()}` or `onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSaveEligibilities(); }}`. This same defect does NOT affect the per-bank Save button (line uses onSave={() => handleSaveBank(idx)} through BankEligibilityRow) nor Delete (handleRemoveBank explicitly passes `remaining`).
